creative_direction: Draw Gintoki Sakata in a pale-blue linen shirt, with his silver curls slightly tousled and his adult face relaxed. His shoulders angle away, but his face returns gently toward the viewer so both eyes remain fully readable. A small amused smile gives the portrait a casual conversational mood. Use hand-drawn ink with broad cool-gray washes and a few pale blue accents, leaving the white hair partly as reserved paper. Keep the collar modest and the background nearly empty. No props are needed; the recognizable hair silhouette, relaxed eyes, and loose shoulder line provide the character. Give both visible irises soft violet Rinnegan rings with a clear dark pupil and bright catchlights. Keep the rings fine and contained so the gaze remains warm and readable. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
